hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f; if echo "$f" | grep -q '.claude-team99' && echo "$f" | grep -q '/memory/'; then printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"ask","permissionDecisionReason":"Memory write: %s"}}' "$f"; fi; }

jq -e '.tool_input | has("offset") or has("limit")' >/dev/null || { echo 'BLOCKED: Read must specify offset or limit param (keep context tight). Use offset+limit for a range, or limit alone for first N lines.' >&2; exit 2; }

jq -c 'if (.tool_input.command|test("^\\s*sed(\\s|$)")) and ((.tool_input.command|test("(^|\\s)(-[a-zA-Z]*i([\\s=.]|$)|--in-place)"))|not) then {hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PreToolUse",permissionDecision:"allow",permissionDecisionReason:"sed read-only (no -i)"}} else empty end'
